topic: SOTA Deterministic NLU Systems for Agentic Intent Resolution

sources.title: An Introduction to Snips NLU
sources.keyClaim: Two-phase NLU: deterministic regex parser first, then probabilistic logistic regression + CRF. Deep learning showed no significant gain over CRFs.

sources.title: Introducing DIET: State-of-the-art architecture
sources.keyClaim: DIET: Dual Intent and Entity Transformer. Shared transformer for intent + entity, 6x faster to train than BERT, comparable accuracy.

sources.title: REIC: RAG-Enhanced Intent Classification at Scale
sources.keyClaim: Hierarchical intent ontology + RAG retrieval + constrained decoding. 8x cost reduction vs proprietary LLMs. Outperforms fine-tuning, zero-shot, few-shot.

sources.title: Routing in agentic AI — how agents choose their path
sources.keyClaim: Four routing mechanisms: LLM-based, embedding-based, rule-based, ML classifier. Each with distinct cost/speed/flexibility trade-offs.

sources.title: Agent Series (5): Intent Recognition and Routing
sources.keyClaim: Confidence threshold routing: >0.8 execute, >0.6 ML classify, <0.6 clarify or LLM fallback. Production pattern validated.

sources.title: NLP Libraries for Node.js and JavaScript
sources.keyClaim: Three-tier JS NLP: Tier 1 Classical (wink, natural, compromise), Tier 2 ML (NLP.js, brain.js), Tier 3 Transformer (transformers.js v4).

sources.title: WinkNLP - NLP in Node.js
sources.keyClaim: 2M tokens/sec, ~100% test coverage, zero dependencies, full TypeScript support, runs in browsers. Best-in-class for preprocessing.

sources.title: Hybrid Intent Classifier in TypeScript
sources.keyClaim: Two-step TypeScript classifier: Levenshtein string similarity for typos, then TF-IDF cosine for semantic matching. Runs 100% client-side.

sources.title: Intent Classification: A Comprehensive Guide for 2025
sources.keyClaim: Three stages: preprocessing, model inference, post-processing. Classical approaches still in use for simple/high-precision needs.

sources.title: NLP Entity Matching with Fuzzy Search
sources.keyClaim: Three-stage pipeline: TF-IDF cosine (candidate gen) → Jaro-Winkler (re-ranking) → embeddings (tie-breaking). Thresholds: auto-accept ≥0.8, manual 0.6-0.8, reject <0.6.

sources.title: Rasa NLU | Structured Intent Recognition with LLM Flexibility
sources.keyClaim: Co-existence Router decides NLU vs LLM per-turn. Classify with structured NLU, fall back to LLMs only when confidence is low.

sources.title: Deterministic and probabilistic agents
sources.keyClaim: 95% of AI pilots fail because teams hand entire workflow to LLM when only part needs LLM. Deterministic agent: same input → same output, predictable cost.

sources.title: OpenAutoNLU: Open Source AutoML Library for NLU
sources.keyClaim: AutoML for NLU: matches/outperforms AutoGluon on intent classification, unsupervised OOD detection without labeled OOD data.

sources.title: Intent Classification: 2026 Techniques for NLP Models
sources.keyClaim: Paraphrasing examples boosts accuracy 78%→86%. Active learning with entropy/margin sampling for continuous improvement.

sources.title: NLP for Conversational AI in 2025
sources.keyClaim: Context-aware NLU: coreference resolution, ellipsis handling, context carryover across turns.

sources.title: Elasticsearch entity resolution: Match entities with LLMs & semantic search
sources.keyClaim: Three-step matching: exact → alias → semantic search (hybrid with RRF). LLM as final match evaluator with explainability.

sources.title: Agent-as-a-Router: Agentic Model Routing for Coding Tasks
sources.keyClaim: C-A-F loop: Context → Action → Feedback → Context. Accumulates execution-grounded experience during deployment.

sources.title: Intent Detection in the Age of LLMs
sources.keyClaim: Hybrid system: uncertainty-based routing between SetFit (sentence transformers) and LLMs. Within 2% of LLM accuracy with 50% less latency.

sources.title: What Structured NLP Does That LLMs Still Can't
sources.keyClaim: Specialized NLP reduces processing costs by 80% vs per-token cloud APIs at petabyte scale. Deterministic entity recognition with clinical context.

sources.title: Rasa Alternatives in 2026
sources.keyClaim: Rasa remains king of on-premise control. Botpress for visual wrapper. Dialogflow CX for contact center. Microsoft Bot Framework for Azure ecosystem.

sources.title: Snips NLU GitHub Repository
sources.keyClaim: Python/Rust NLU library. Deterministic parser (regex) + probabilistic parser (logistic regression + CRF). 100-200MB RAM. Entity resolution built-in.

sources.title: Beyond Prompt Engineering: Deep-Dive RAG for Intent Detection
sources.keyClaim: RAG-driven NLU: decouple intent dataset from LLM prompt. Scale to hundreds of intents, reduce latency and API costs.

sources.title: Scaling Intent Understanding: A Framework for Classification
sources.keyClaim: Domain-agnostic framework: lightweight open-source LLMs + clarifying questions. 8X cost reduction, 8% misrouting reduction in e-commerce.

sources.title: Intent Classifier — REIC Implementation
sources.keyClaim: Semantic routing (SentenceTransformers) + RAG for few-shot evidence + hierarchical routing + multi-turn conversation support.
